description: Meta ops + multi-op maneuvers. Phase A = serial single-op. open_warm is opt-in only (piles multi-instance windows).

ops.label: Cold/fresh open (close prior, spawn, settle, close)
ops.notes: Each sample: open → settle → close (no leftover pile)

ops.label: Warm open (process already running; launch again)
ops.notes: OPT-IN ONLY. After a living window exists: launch again without killing first. Multi-instance → piles windows; excluded from default full-suite.

ops.label: change_workspace to spare then back intent
ops.notes: Move window to workspace index+1 (mod n); measures workspace Meta churn

ops.label: Focus other workspace then back (window stays)
ops.notes: Visibility/restack: switch active WS away and back without moving window

ops.label: minimize then unminimize
ops.notes: Compound but atomic product path; settle after unminimize

maneuvers.label: open → delay D → move_resize → settle
maneuvers.notes: 2-step thrash sweep: high D → down until thrash

maneuvers.label: open → D1 → move_to_monitor → D2 → move_resize → settle
maneuvers.notes: 3-step isolation sweep (lock one delay, thrash-search the other)
